notices.expiredText: The seats went back on sale. Pick them again if they are still free.

notices.taken_other: Seats you picked were just taken and were removed from your selection.

notices.max_other: You can pick up to {{count}} seats per order.

pending.title: left to pay for your order

checkout.title: Checkout
checkout.holdText: Your order is held for you until the timer runs out. Pay before then or the seats go back on sale.
checkout.notFoundText: This order does not exist or belongs to another account.

pay.title: Payment
pay.demoText: No real card data is collected and no money moves. Pressing Pay only tells the demo payment service to succeed or fail.

failed.title: The payment did not go through
failed.text: Nothing was charged and your hold was released. Try again to hold the same seats again, or choose different ones.

expired.title: Your hold expired
expired.text: The time to pay ran out and the seats went back on sale. Choose them again if they are still free.
expired.lostTitle: Your seats are no longer held
expired.lostText: Another tab or device replaced your hold, so these seats are no longer reserved for you. Choose seats again.

confirmation.title: Order confirmation
confirmation.paid: Payment received. Your tickets are ready.
confirmation.demoNote: Demo payment: no money was charged.

status.PENDING_PAYMENT: This order is waiting for payment
status.FAILED: The payment for this order failed
